The "Big 3" pharmaceutical wholesalers in the United States are McKesson Corporation, Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen), and Cardinal Health. Together, this dominant trio controls over 90% of the entire U.S. prescription drug wholesale distribution market. [](https://www.business.com/articles/pharmaceutical-wholesalers/)

- **McKesson Corporation:** Headquartered in Irving, Texas (historically San Francisco), McKesson is the largest of the three, supplying roughly a third of all prescription medicines in North America. [](https://www.business.com/articles/pharmaceutical-wholesalers/)

- **Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen):** Based in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania, the company rebranded to Cencora to reflect its expanding international reach, particularly in Europe following its acquisition of Alliance Healthcare. [](https://www.business.com/articles/pharmaceutical-wholesalers/)

- **Cardinal Health:**

Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, Cardinal Health is a major global distributor of pharmaceuticals, medical products, and laboratory supplies.
